# frame time scale

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to wire a [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalFrame.md) to its single underlying [`gmeow:TimeScale`](../classes/gmeow-TimeScale.md) — the mandatory 'which clock' component of every frame.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting two scales on one frame (it is functional — a frame has exactly one) and avoid putting calendar or timezone information here; those are separate frame components.

### How to use

- Set exactly one seeded [`gmeow:TimeScale`](../classes/gmeow-TimeScale.md) individual; pair with optional [`gmeow:frameCalendarSystem`](gmeow-frameCalendarSystem.md) and [`gmeow:frameReferencePosition`](gmeow-frameReferencePosition.md) to complete the frame.

### Examples

- ex:myFrame [`gmeow:frameTimeScale`](gmeow-frameTimeScale.md) [`gmeow:timeScaleUTC`](../individuals/gmeow-timeScaleUTC.md).
